title: S05 · Choose an Optimization and Prove Its Value

Подготовь только синтетические данные и исходное состояние упражнения. Покажи одинаковый fixture до и после изменения. Сначала assertions результата, затем сопоставимые метрики. Отдели локальный algorithm proxy от измерения Salesforce CPU. Запиши финальный пример отдельным коротким проходом, затем верни исходное состояние. Here is our practical task. Choose two candidates from the evidence cards and prepare an approval-ready optimization note.
МОНТАЖ ПОЗЖЕ. Вставь 6–10 секунд подготовленного результата. Это preview результата; пошаговую сборку покажи дальше без пропуска важных решений.

By the end, you should be able to show the result and explain how you checked it. The recommendation follows evidence and business use rather than the amount of code changed. No exact speedup is promised without observed comparable measurements.

cues.label: 02 · The longest code file is not automatically the best target

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «The longest code file is not automatically the best target». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar has five proposed improvements: reduce the vehicle list's initial payload, replace a nested lookup loop, move a slow optional callout out of the save path, rewrite every Flow in Apex, and add a cache to a rarely used report. Oleg can fund only two this iteration. A senior recommendation should connect each change to a specific complaint, not simply prefer the most technically interesting option. Value depends on frequency and consequence as well as duration. Saving half a second on an action repeated constantly may matter more than saving several seconds on a monthly administrative task. A correctness defect or a missed operational deadline can outweigh both. Write the affected population and business consequence before comparing implementation effort.

ЭКРАН. Раздел «Use a small decision table». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

For each candidate, record the observed problem, the proposed mechanism, expected direction of improvement, risks, effort range, and a way to verify the result. Expected direction can be useful without an exact percentage. Reducing unused response fields should reduce payload size; it does not by itself establish how much faster Max's complete journey becomes. The synthetic evidence cards below support investigating the payload and collection loop first. They do not prove either is the final production bottleneck. The broad rewrite has a large change surface and no isolated explanation for the reported symptoms. A change surface is the set of behaviors and components that might be affected. Larger surfaces demand more regression evidence and can make recovery harder.

ЭКРАН · КОД. Открой пример «Synthetic prioritization cards» рядом с ожидаемым результатом. Выделяй вход, решение и выход; не читай весь листинг вслух. Перед запуском используй prerequisites и точную команду из урока. Запиши фактический вывод, включая ошибку, если она возникла.

The example on screen is Synthetic prioritization cards. Before running it, identify the input, the branch that makes the decision, and the result we expect. We will compare that expectation with the actual output.

ЭКРАН. Раздел «Define success before editing». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

For the payload change, preserve the fields required for Max's task and the same permitted record set. Measure response size and user-visible wait separately. For the lookup change, verify the same computed result across empty, single-record, and bulk inputs, then record the relevant counters or repeatable local comparison count. A reduced operation count supports the algorithmic explanation; actual timing still requires measurement. Choose a baseline revision and keep the comparison environment, data fixture, persona, and cache conditions as consistent as practical. Record unsuccessful runs instead of silently discarding them. If external conditions change, say so. A small table of raw observations is more useful than a single percentage without its denominator.

cues.label: 05 · Plan the release and the decision to stop

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Plan the release and the decision to stop». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A reversible change has a practical way back to the previous behavior. A feature toggle may help separate deployment from user exposure, but the team must test both paths and define who changes the toggle. Removing data or changing an external contract can require a recovery plan beyond a code revert. After the chosen change, compare the agreed signals. If improvement is smaller than hoped, revisit the hypothesis rather than selecting a more flattering metric. If the target is met and the remaining imperfection has low business impact, stop. Every additional optimization has an opportunity cost and can introduce a new defect.
For the practical work, create a five-row table with affected journey, evidence, mechanism, uncertainty, effort, and regression risk.

ЭКРАН. Вернись к результату упражнения. Покажи evidence, а не зелёный статус без деталей. Затем открой практическую задачу и остановись перед готовым решением.

A before-and-after label requires actual comparable observations, not two imagined values. Now pause the video and try the exercise yourself. Choose two candidates from the evidence cards and prepare an approval-ready optimization note. The recommendation follows evidence and business use rather than the amount of code changed. No exact speedup is promised without observed comparable measurements. The verification plan includes permissions and data correctness, not only response time.
Before you finish, answer this question in your own words. Why might a smaller improvement have greater business value?
ПРИ ЗАПИСИ. Пауза 4 секунды. Не показывай ответ раньше вопроса. Затем открой объяснение и сравни его с проверяемым результатом.

It may affect a much more frequent or important journey while carrying less delivery risk. Save your work with the expected and actual results. If a check was not run, say which one remains and what you would need to run it.
